title: K-9 Saxon: from near-fatal trauma to the Saxon Award.
text: In 2002, Fresno Police K-9 Saxon survived catastrophic line-of-duty injuries. A contemporaneous letter from Police Chief Jerry Dyer published in Biopure's Annual Report described Oxyglobin as playing a pivotal role in his survival. Fresno Police later named the Saxon Award in his honor.
why: A documented veterinary HBOC case linking emergency oxygen-carrying support, working-dog trauma and an institutional legacy preserved in Fresno Police policy.
